source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Wear gloves alone because clothing protection is unnecessary once the client has left the room.","B":"Wear a surgical mask and eye protection without gloves because Contact Precautions apply only while the client is present.","C":"Wear a gown or protective apron and gloves appropriate for terminal cleaning in a Contact Precautions environment.","D":"Wear an N95 respirator without gown or gloves because airborne protection replaces contact-barrier PPE during terminal cleaning."}}
source_row.rationale: CDC environmental-cleaning guidance lists gown/apron and reusable gloves for routine and terminal cleaning of areas under Contact Precautions. The original vague statement was narrowed to the PPE recommended for this specific cleaning task.
source_row.source_detail: PPE table: Contact Precautions routine and terminal cleaning require gown/apron and gloves Source has no separate formal version identifier in the cited page metadata; live currentness and applicability rechecked 2026-08-15.
